output.question: Who is the parent company of Old Navy?
output.answer: Old Navy's parent company is Gap Inc. Gap Inc.'s official Old Navy press release dated November 5, 2026 says Old Navy was founded in 1994 as part of San Francisco-based Gap Inc., confirming the relationship as of November 11, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Old Navy was founded in 1994 as part of San Francisco-based Gap Inc.
Gap Inc.'s corporate website identifies Old Navy as one of its four brands.

passages.quote: Founded in 1994 as part of San Francisco-based Gap Inc. (NYSE: GAP), Old Navy operates more than 1,200 stores across the United States and Canada, as well as franchise locations around the world.
We inspire self-expression through four of the most iconic American brands — Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta.
